survival_distribution_usability.usable_note: Usable for the question it was built to answer, and the censoring question is SETTLED rather than merely improved: pct_right_censored_pooled = 0.000 exactly. There is no censored observation to model around, no survival-analysis machinery required, and no estimator sensitivity to a censoring assumption -- the empirical distribution IS the 8 draws. The pre-registered adequacy bar (MIN_UNCENSORED_DEATHS_TOTAL=4) cleared at 2x.
supports: A firm qualitative answer: on this ecology tier an unbroken single life reliably ends in genuine health_depleted death well inside 3000 steps (8/8).
A crude central tendency: mean 1715, median 1831, approx 95% interval on the mean 1154-2275. Quote the interval, never the point estimate alone.

A decisive refutation of the run's OWN imported calibration assumption: the driver extrapolated V3-EXQ-912's segment hazard (p ~= 4/60 = 6.7% per 500 steps) as approximately memoryless, predicting mean death ~7500 steps and ~6.2% censoring per seed. Observed mean 1715 -- 4.4x earlier -- with 0% censoring. Hazard RISES with within-life time: a wear process. Consistent with 912 rather than contradicting it, since every 912 segment began with a fresh body and its estimate was therefore a fresh-body hazard, structurally blind to the wear term.

A demonstration that 912's death-time distribution was a TRUNCATION ARTEFACT: 912 spanned 261-487 steps (mean 382), 920a spans 628-2527. The two ranges are DISJOINT with no overlap -- every single-life death here occurred later than the longest death 912 was structurally able to observe. 912's figure was a conditional-on-dying-within-500-steps distribution and must not be cited as an organism survival distribution.

A dose-vs-time result, the strongest scientific content in the run: harm-event counts reconstructed EXACTLY from lifetime_affective_occupancy (frac_harm_event x n_lived_steps_measured recovers integers exactly) are 93, 88, 81, 72, 98, 57, 94, 73 -- mean 82.0, sd 14.0, CV 0.170, max/min 1.72. Against survival TIME at CV 0.391 and max/min 4.02, cumulative harm dose at death is 2.3x MORE STEREOTYPED than time to death. Spearman(harm-event rate, survival steps) = -0.881. Natural reading: death occurs at an approximately fixed harm tolerance and survival time is that budget divided by encounter rate -- a harm-dose distribution wearing the clothes of a survival distribution. Descriptive at n=8, not a claim.
does_not_support: No distributional shape. 8 points cannot distinguish lognormal from Weibull from gamma and cannot estimate a hazard function. The wear-vs-memoryless call is a gross-magnitude argument (4.4x), not a fitted comparison.
No between-condition inference. There is one arm; nothing is compared to anything.
No competence inference in either direction -- the environment makes death eventually certain (see failure_location).
The harm-dose result is n=8 and reconstructed from a summary statistic. A hypothesis worth one cheap reanalysis, not a finding to build on.
No pooling with the 08-11 run or with V3-EXQ-912 (different substrate, different design).

The seed-3 anomaly is unexplained and must not be smoothed over: seed 3 spent 91.9% of its life in the zero-harm reef yet carried the second-highest harm-event RATE (0.0714) and died second-earliest (1008 steps). Reef occupancy across seeds is essentially uncorrelated with survival (Spearman +0.095). Sheltering did not buy life. Answerable from the already-committed episode log.

supersession_analysis.relationship: fix-validation, and a functional supersession that is NOWHERE DECLARED
supersession_analysis.classification: Fix-validation of an INFRASTRUCTURE defect. The queue entry that produced it (ree-v3 8fc8bd3) states it verbatim: 'V3-EXQ-920a: multi-seed re-run of 920 (explicit --seeds 0..7; workaround for runner seeds-not-in-CLI defect, per 916/920 autopsy Target 4; smoke PASS)'. That is a direct, named consumption of the confirmed 2026-08-12 cluster autopsy's Target-4 routing (routing: queue-experiment), whose diagnosis was that the 08-11 FAIL was not a scientific finding at all -- the queue declared seeds:8 but experiment_runner.run_experiment() builds subprocess CLI args only from the item's `args` field, so the driver's own --seeds default [0] silently governed.
supersession_analysis.supersedes_finding: Under the EXQ versioning policy a lettered iteration supersedes its predecessor, and the predecessor's evidence should not continue weighting governance where the bug invalidated its result. That condition is squarely met -- the 08-11 result was invalidated by an execution defect and 920a is the corrected iteration of the identical question on byte-identical config. Yet: neither manifest carries `supersedes`; the 920a queue entry carries no `supersedes`; the 08-11 manifest's evidence_direction was never set to `superseded`; and the driver-generated summary_markdown -- IDENTICAL text in both runs -- says only 'Supersedes V3-EXQ-912's segment-count-scaling workaround', a METHODOLOGICAL statement about a DIFFERENT experiment. A reader of the 08-14 artifact alone has no way to learn a failed predecessor exists. Practical governance exposure is limited rather than absent: the 08-11 run was already adjudicated non_contributory + standard by the confirmed cluster artifact, so it is not silently weighting anything. What is lost is the MECHANICAL link -- the indexer's supersession path (evidence_direction: 'superseded' -> inactive) is never engaged, and the two runs remain separable only by timestamp.
supersession_analysis.do_not_pool: The 08-11 single life (seed 0, 1475 steps, health_depleted) falls inside the 08-14 distribution, which is a pleasing independent cross-machine consistency check -- but it is NOT a ninth data point. The substrate hash differs across 114 commits and seed 0 itself realised 1475 steps on the old substrate versus 1944 on the new, a 32% shift on a FIXED seed, so the two runs are not bit-comparable and the drift demonstrably changed the trajectory. n stays 8; any later citation must quote n=8, never n=9.

A LETTERED queue_id whose run_id OMITS the letter defeats stem-keyed de-duplication and coverage checks. Measured corpus-wide over evidence/experiments/*.json: 733 manifests carry both ids; 376 have a lettered queue_id; 17 of those (4.5%) have a run_id omitting the letter; and 10 distinct run_id STEMS are shared by 2+ queue_ids. Of the 17, 8 are the SD-068 family whose run_ids never encode the number but DO separate variants by descriptive slug (only 778b/778c actually collide), and 9 are genuine letter-drops (612c, 612d, 737a, 737b, 742a, 742b, 766a, 914a, 920a). Of the 10 stem collisions, 6 are the letter-drop shape, spanning 6 unrelated families from 2026-05 to 2026-08. HONEST SCALE: rare (1.4% of manifests, 2.4% of lettered ids) but RECURRING and UNFIXED -- not systemic, and not historical either. No evidence has been lost, since the fully-timestamped run_id IS unique corpus-wide; the exposure is that stem-keyed consumers silently under-report, which is exactly how this session's parent nearly re-autopsied an already-covered run. ROOT CAUSE IS STRUCTURAL, not an authoring slip: EXPERIMENT_TYPE is a module-level constant (driver line 271) and the driver has no access to its runner-supplied queue_id, so any same-driver-different-arguments re-queue reproduces it. Two independent fixes: consumers key on the FULL run_id or (queue_id, run_id) never the stem; producers thread queue_id into the run-pack key.

`all_seeds_completed` is structurally blind to the defect its own description names. Its description reads 'no early crash/truncation silently shrinking n' but its implementation (driver line 504) is n_seeds_total == len(seeds), where `seeds` is the list THE PROCESS WAS INVOKED WITH. On the 08-11 run it reported measured 1.0 / threshold 1.0 / met:true -- a clean pass -- while 7 of the 8 queue-DECLARED seeds never executed. A criterion that checks a run against its own arguments cannot detect that the arguments were wrong. This is the driver-side complement to the 2026-08-12 Target-4 runner-side finding (experiment_runner builds CLI args only from `args`, never from the declarative `seeds` count).

A manifest's interpretive note can go STALE against its own substrate. Both interpretation.note and summary.md tell a future reader -- naming /failure-autopsy explicitly -- that 0 sleep cycles is EXPECTED because 'a TRUE single unbroken life can NEVER sleep during that life, no matter how long it runs'. That structural claim was true for the 08-11 substrate and is FALSE for the target's: 5f14036 (sleep_substrate:GAP-9 v1 ceiling arm, within-life sleep trigger) and c38e083 (MELConsumer.need_crossed() + notify_waking_step wiring, registering the flag) are ANCESTORS of bf769fb3a445 and NOT of fc0fb4ce5c7b. The knob is use_within_life_sleep_trigger: bool = False (ree_core/utils/config.py:5426) and it is absent from this run's enabled_default_off_flags. The outcome value is right; the RECORDED REASON is wrong, and wrong in the direction that misdirects -- a reader following the note would conclude substrate work is still owed when it has landed. Standing 'claim status is not the flag default -- check the knob first' pattern, arriving inside a manifest's own prose. Consequence: 920a's design is the only bed in the corpus that can exercise a within-life sleep trigger (only run with a continuous unbroken life), and the designated validation v3_exq_931_sleep_gap9_need_arm is authored with no runs recorded.

chan_max_std is a MAX ACROSS SEEDS, so channel non-degeneracy criteria are NOT seed-invariant -- they become monotonically easier to pass as seed count rises. channel_vigor read `false` at n=1 (08-11) and `true` at n=8 (08-14) with no relevant substrate change. Never read such a flip as evidence of a substrate change.

hypothesis_space_ledger_pending.reasoning: Step 9b applies when the autopsy either (i) emits a fanout_recommendation or (ii) adjudicates a leg (a target with a recommended_evidence_direction). No fanout_recommendation is emitted -- there is no discrimination bottleneck, the run answered its own question, and the outstanding items are buildable analyses rather than rival hypotheses needing a portfolio. Condition (ii) is met only in the thinnest formal sense: this target carries recommended_evidence_direction: non_contributory, but with claim_ids: [] it adjudicates no pre-registered LEG of any registered question, and no existing qid names this run's adjudicating queue_id. Appending would therefore mean OPENING A NEW QUESTION whose single hypothesis is born already resolved -- and that is not what Mode C is for (Mode C is a genuinely unanticipated rival surfacing on an EXISTING question, and it attaches to an existing qid by construction). Registering a one-hypothesis question purely to record a successful characterization would inflate total_initial with a leg that narrowed no rival set, which is exactly the denominator-inflation the frozen-set invariants exist to police.

if_the_confirming_session_disagrees.candidate_title: Is single-continuous-life mortality on the 906b ecology tier dose-determined (fixed harm tolerance) or time-determined (constant hazard)?

candidate_hypotheses.label: Constant hazard (memoryless)
candidate_hypotheses.desc: Within-life death hazard is approximately constant, as extrapolated from V3-EXQ-912's fresh-body segment hazard (p ~= 6.7% per 500 steps), predicting mean death ~7500 steps and ~6.2% censoring per seed.
candidate_hypotheses.basis: The driver's own STEP-BUDGET CALIBRATION imported this assumption explicitly and pre-registered this run as its correct test.
candidate_hypotheses.proposed_bar: control_passed true (harm_pathway_trained and core_channels_non_degenerate both cleared), non_degenerate true (all 13 criteria_non_degenerate keys true), met_elimination_bar true
candidate_hypotheses.proposed_basis: Observed mean 1715 steps vs ~7500 predicted (4.4x earlier) with 0.000 censoring vs 6.2% predicted. Hazard rises with within-life time.

candidate_hypotheses.label: Fixed harm-tolerance budget
